5 Section 2 - 12 – Setback Building Line The "setback building line" is the line established beyond which the front line of any building may not extend. Section 2 - 1 3 – Yard A "yard" is space on the same lot with the dwelling, extending from the lot line to the nearest wall of the dwelling, unobstructed from the ground to the sky except as otherwise provided therein. The depth of the yard is the mean distance between these two lines. A "front yard" is the yard across the full width of the lot extending from the dwelling to the front lot line. A "side yard" is the yard between the dwelling and the side line of the lot and extending from the f ront yard to the rear yard. A "rear yard" is the yard across the full width of the lot between the rear line of the dwelling and the rear lot line.
